comment: 'turn' counts model calls, not user-visible turns: turns 1-2 are both the FIRST cli turn (list_dir runs and is approved, then create is proposed). Esc denies the create and ends the turn, so turn 3 is the next cli turn - there is no model call in between.

match.comment: 4: [user1, user(list_dir result), user(denial result)] committed from the stopped turn (the two empty pre-tool-call assistant messages are dropped by the Mistral-compat empty-assistant guard), plus this turn's own user message. The completed list_dir call and its result are in there - that's the regression this test pins.
